forward.teaches: FORWARD moves every robot one step.

turn.teaches: A colour command turns that colour a quarter turn clockwise, then everyone steps.

wait-at-wall.teaches: A robot that walks into the edge waits there, so stragglers catch up.

two-colours.teaches: Only the commanded colour turns, but every robot steps.

wall-stopper.teaches: A wall inside the board parks a robot while the rest walks on.

three-rights.teaches: Turns go clockwise only: a left turn is three rights, and the robot walks while it turns.

queue.teaches: Robots in a line wait for the one in front.

same-colour.teaches: One colour, different headings: one press sends them different ways.

conflict.teaches: Two robots that want the same cell both stay where they are.

exit-sides.teaches: The exit can be entered from every open side.

together.teaches: Several robots may enter the exit in the same move.

three-colours.teaches: Three colours: three kinds of turn to keep apart.

tight.teaches: A small board: no room to walk around each other.

long-board.teaches: A long, narrow board: the order in the corridor decides.

crowd.teaches: Many robots: one command, many consequences.

big.teaches: The largest board: long walks, and time to see a plan unfold.

turn-tile.teaches: A turn tile turns whoever steps onto it: the board does the turning.

tile-to-avoid.teaches: A turn tile in the way: stepping onto it sends a robot the wrong way.
